designs.why: Strong, ownable one-ink back print: the lit flank vs. dark north face reads clearly from 3 m, the engraved line quality is fine and premium, and the headlamp dots add a story. Weak spots: the right-edge lines trail off in ragged horizontal streaks that look like a glitch rather than a deliberate vignette, the bottom fades into a flat stack of lines that feels unfinished, and the dashed shadow texture on the north face turns noisy and muddy at distance.
designs.fix: Tidy the vignette: end the right and bottom lines in a smooth, even oval fade (graduated spacing and staggered ends instead of long ragged streaks) so the edge looks deliberate.
